ticks.note: A train approaches: the lights start flashing.
`if 3 true` counts the ticks after `Warning` was entered: this is the first.
The third tick: the barrier comes down.
The train has cleared the crossing: the barrier goes up, the lights keep flashing.
Two ticks later the lights stop and the crossing is open again.
A fault: `abort to Failsafe` leaves `Normal` whatever it was doing, with the lights on and the barrier down.
Repaired: back to `Normal`, which starts again in `Open`.
